Bookkeeping is the most basic of all accounting functions. It involves maintaining accurate and updated records of your company's financial activities. Our methodology includes bank reconciliation, purchase and sale records, and regulatory filings. These records are essential to regulatory compliance. Proper bookkeeping makes other accounting functions such as audits, payroll, and tax preparation, much simpler and less time consuming.

It is important to conduct periodic review and analysis of your company's financial performance. This includes the preparation of financial statements and reporting for internal and external use with focus on management, corporate and statutory requirements. These reviews are an important part of regulatory compliance and shareholder disclosures. Additionally, financial analysis can provide valuable insight into your company's financial health which can help you make sound decisions for the future.

Payroll is a critical business operations function. It involves managing all employee compensations, benefits, and withholdings. We manage your payroll on an ongoing basis, ensuring that all employees are compensated according to their employment agreements and benefit selections. This also includes the processing of PAYE Tax for employees excluding the actual tax paid as the actual tax is based.

Commercial tax preparation requires that records and submissions must be prepared carefully. The records must be accurate in order to minimize your risk of unforeseen tax liabilities, fees, or audits. Our team will work with you to prepare complete and accurate corporate tax filings on an annual basis.

Our financial consulting services are designed to provide you with expert analysis and advice regarding your company's strategic decisions. As you consider exploring business opportunities, investments, and partnerships. It is important to understand the short, medium, and long-term ramnifications of your decisions. Our financial consulting services make it easy to understand the financial impact your decisions will have on your company's future.
